Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in the "Updated Understanding" section. After the WebSurfer correctly retrieved data from a search result snippet stating "48.8 percent was Muslim" (which matches the ground truth), the Planner hallucinated a new, incorrect figure of "approximately 59%" (citing a common citation but ignoring the specific data retrieved). The Planner failed to synthesize the correct information found by the WebSurfer and instead introduced an incorrect value, leading to the wrong final answer.
